address: via Plan de Corones 10, San Vigilio di Marebbe, 39030, Italy
bio: The three small dining rooms at this restaurant include a bright and airy room overlooking the village and a historic Stube with a romantic feel. The cuisine here is typically Ladin in flavour, with the option of daily specials and an à la carte, while the efficient service comes courtesy of staff in local costume. Owner-chef Alma Willet’s friendly welcome and a charming outdoor space for summer dining complete the picture....
